info.name: [beta] Return a PDF Export for a Form Submission.

params.name: pdfId
params.description: ID of the form submission PDF export.

items.docs: Returns a PDF export for a form submission. **Beta:** This endpoint is in beta and is likely to change before being broadly available. Reach out to your Samsara Representative to have Forms APIs enabled for your organization. Rate limit: 100 requests/min (learn more about rate limits here). To use this endpoint, select **Read Form Submissions** under the Closed Beta category when creating or editing an API

params.description: ID of the form submission to create a PDF export from.
